name: ELKS/RAB6-interacting/CAST family member 1
pathways: positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction

function.text: ERC1 encodes ELKS/Rab6-interacting/CAST family member 1. Annotated molecular activities include structural constituent of presynaptic active zone and cadherin binding. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.
